fixes.explanation: The text says, “The king stood up to greet her, bowed to her, and sat down on his throne.” (1 Kings 2:19) The KING gets up when his mother walks in. Solomon has an entire kingdom, and when Mama shows up, he's standing, he's bowing, he's NOT staying comfy. I respect it, because I have never seen a man move that fast.

Right on. “…the king had a throne brought for his mother, who sat down at his right hand.” (1 Kings 2:19) Solomon doesn't just find her a spot. He has a whole throne brought in. I spent years on a pile of takeout menus in a junk drawer, and nobody ever brought ME a throne. Not one. Not even a stool with a good attitude.
